reviews.text: I was very nervous about my little dog going on group walks but knew it was going to be good for her confidence. Elodie and Emma put me at ease with the consultation straight away. From the moment Emma started walking her, her kindness, patience and genuine love for dogs shown through and my dog’s confidence grew and grew! Thank you so much Pawsome walks!

Elodie walked our whippet Beau for the last few years until we moved out of the area. When Beau first started with Elodie, she was quite nervous around other dogs and really shy, but over the last few years she has really grown in confidence and is much less nervous with other dogs when out with us too!

Elodie really cares for all of the dogs she walks, sending pictures or videos, which we love to receive, and always so thoughtful with little gifts for Christmas. If you’re looking for a dog walker Elodie and Pawsome Walks are just the best!

Elodie has walked our two dogs for the last 6 years. Quite simply, there is nobody better. Regardless of the time lapse in engagements (holidays) the dogs are always excited to see Elodie. Her bubbly character and big smile are matched by wagging tales. We are delighted that Elodie continues to find availability when we need her. She treats our dogs as if they were her own. They love her ... as do we!

Pawsome walks are amazing! Always post the best pictures of the dog's adventures for every walk so that is parents know what they have been up to.  Our pup loves going on his walks which speaks for itself. I can not recommend them enough.

They are so professionals! My dog Touko is a large alsacian/malamute cross breed and can be quite reactive sometimes. Elodie never had any issue with him, dogs are so happy in their packs and the team always make sure each dog is provided with all the mental and physical stimulations specific to their breeds needs. Always tons of pictures and updates if you choose to follow them on their adventures.
The daily enthusiasm and care are so heart warming and it feels good to be able to trust people blindly with your loving family pet ❤️
Simply the best !
Highly recommend Elodie and Pawsome Walks.  She has been walking our dog since she was a puppy and has always provides excellent care and diligence in addition to being prepared to go the extra mile.

Elodie has been walking our rescue dog for 2 years and we could not be happier with the love, care and fun that she experiences on the walks! She is a rescue dog who can be reactive but Elodie has brought out the best in her and she always comes back happy, relaxed and exhausted. We love looking at the photos from the walk and could not be happier.

Emma and Elodie are absolutely amazing and I couldn’t ask for anything more from someone looking after your treasured pooch. Emma looks after Daphne like she’s her own and seeing Emma is definitely the highlight of Daphne’s week. They are flexible and considerate and offer puppy visits as well as walks. Thank you for being so lovely and looking after Daphne and sometimes Misty so well!
Absolutley amazing! My boys love the walks and I have a very hyper boy, elodie is so good with them

We cannot recommend Emma and Elodie enough. Emma has cared for our little puppy Rocket since he was 12 weeks old. We could trust her completely and Rocket absolutely loved his time with Emma and the other doggies. Elodie and Emma both made getting our first puppy so much easier and less stressful, as we knew we could always rely on them. We are gutted to have moved away and wrenched Rocket from his much loved walks!
Great service and communication. Very reliable and accommodating.. Bella  loves her walks/outings. Would highly recommend.

Elodie and her team have looked after my pup from the age of 13 weeks old! From puppy visits with Sue to graduating to group walks the care has been wonderful. Elodie is professional and flexible and puts the dogs first in everything she does. I wouldn’t hesitate to recommend pawsome walks!
Rufus loves his walks with Ryan and we love being able to see what he has been getting up to on the videos!
